meta.source: Official Cub Scout Training Scheme 2025-08 simplified version + PT/68

L1.purpose_en: World Membership Badge - basic understanding of Cub Scouting, complete within 3 months
L1.description_en: Help new members understand Cub Scouting. Safe from Harm mandatory from 2025-07-01.

L1-01.name_en: Know yourself: tell your leader your interests, hobbies and strengths

L1-02.name_en: Know your Six: tell your Six colour and names of all Six members, Sixer and Seconder

L1-03A.name_en: Know your Group - know all members and leaders after two Pack meetings

L1-03B.name_en: Know your Scout Group number, District, Region and Sponsoring body

L1-04.name_en: Country: identify national flag of PRC and HKSAR regional flag and explain meanings

L1-05.name_en: Know Cub Scout badges (shape and meaning)
L1-05.detail_en: Membership, Progressive (Award, Adventure, Adventure Crest, Golden Bauhinia), Activity (at least 4), Scout Link Badge

L1-05B.name_en: Cub Scout Progressive Badges (Award, Adventure, Adventure Crest, Golden Bauhinia)

L1-06A.name_en: Tell the story of Mowgli joining the wolf pack and its meaning

L1-06B.name_en: Name other characters (animals) in the Jungle Book

L1-06C.name_en: Know the meaning of the Pack Call

L1-07A.name_en: Alert - know call and hand sign and respond quickly

L1-08A.name_en: National flag & anthem: recognise anthem and show proper etiquette during anthem and flag raising

L1-08B.name_en: Salute: know when to use full, half, handshake and eyes-front salutes and correct method

L1-08C.name_en: Pack Call: correct method and call, participate and rehearse

L1-08D.name_en: Flag break: meaning, procedure and participate in Pack flag break

L1-08E.name_en: Promise: meaning of investiture, rehearse ceremony

L1-08F.name_en: Uniform: correct pattern and badge placement

L1-08G2.name_en: Practice Promise and Law in daily life

L1-08G3.name_en: Know Scout Motto and its meaning

L1-09A1.name_en: Scout origins - Brownsea first camp 1907, Boy Scouts, Wolf Cubs 1916, Lady Baden-Powell started Girl Guides

L1-09B1.name_en: Scout Family - 5 Sections in HK: Grasshopper, Cub, Scout, Venture, Rover

L1-09B2.name_en: Closest to Cubs are Grasshoppers and Scouts; parents, other leaders, GSL and Group Council support Pack

L1-10.name_en: Know basic measures to protect self and others from harm (Safe from Harm mandatory from 2025-07-01)

L2.purpose_en: Basic course, complete within 6 months after investiture, all mandatory

L2-TRACK-01.name_en: Follow some tracking signs on a tracking trail

L2-TRACK-02.name_en: Lay tracking signs for other Cubs to follow

L2-TRACK-03.name_en: Draw a tracking sign chart or make a model

L2-KNOT-02.name_en: Know reef knot method and uses

L2-GOOD-01.name_en: Make a good-turn diary for one week

L2-FA-01.name_en: Know basic first aid including cleaning and dressing small wounds

L2-PROMISE-01.name_en: Explain to leader daily examples of living Promise and Law

L2-FAMILY2-01.name_en: Join one Group/District/Region/Association activity or joint activity with another Pack

L2-FAMILY2-02.name_en: Know Scout Family - 5 Sections similarities and differences

L3.purpose_en: Complete within 1 year after Cub Scout Award; partly mandatory, rest 1-2 electives by ability/interest

L3-OUT-MAP-01.name_en: Know 8 map symbols and find on map

L3-OUT-MAP-02.name_en: Find symbols on map and draw in album or stick photos

L3-OUT-COOK-01.name_en: Cook simple food on BBQ grill

L3-OUT-COOK-02.name_en: Boil a set of food in mess tin

L3-OUT-COOK-03.name_en: Wrap food in foil and bake under grill

L3-OUT-COMP-01.name_en: Tell location of buildings or objects

L3-OUT-HIKE-02.name_en: Complete a nature trail or family trail with leader/adult

L3-OUT-PION-01.name_en: Make small pioneering using string, plastic strip and wooden sticks

L3-OUT-CAMP.name_en: Camp or Pack Holiday (must choose at least one or both)

L3-OUT-CAMP-01.name_en: Know how to pack a rucksack and pack yourself

L3-OUT-CAMP-02.name_en: Join a camp or pack holiday

L3-OUT-CAMP-03.name_en: Follow campsite rules and stay safe

L3-SPORT-01.name_en: Show sportsmanship and teamwork in Pack

L3-HELP-FA-02.name_en: Know how to handle nosebleed, cuts, burns

L3-HELP-WATER-02.name_en: Promote water safety rules to others

L3-HELP-SPECIAL.name_en: Special good turn - record in notebook and tell leader

L3-SELF-01.name_en: Take care of yourself in daily life

L3-CRE-MUSIC.name_en: Music: sing a song or play an instrument

L3-CRE-FAITH.name_en: Duty to God: take part in Scouts' Own

L3-CRE-REPORTER.name_en: Reporter: interview someone and report, or report an event

L3-CRE-ART.name_en: Art: draw themed picture, 4+ comics/cartoon telling short story

L3-CRE-MAGIC.name_en: Magic: perform a magic trick with props

L3-CRE-PHOTO.name_en: Photography: take themed photos or 3-min video and explain

L3-CRE-CRAFT.name_en: Craft: make model or useful gadget

L3-CRE-OTHER.name_en: Other creativity: any idea approved by leader

L3-COM-INFO.name_en: Community info: introduce location, environment, history, landmarks

L3-COM-SURVEY.name_en: Community survey: report with text and photos

L3-COM-VISIT.name_en: Community walk: visit facilities and report

L3-COM-PEOPLE.name_en: Community people: interview community worker, describe job and contribution

L3-CUL-CHINA.name_en: Chinese customs: scrapbook on festivals/origins and crafts

L3-CUL-FLAGS.name_en: Know national emblem/flag, regional emblem/flag and meanings

L3-CUL-CHARITY.name_en: HK charities: brief history and work

L3-PRO-01.name_en: Practice Cub Scout Promise and Law in daily life

L3-FAM3-01.name_en: Know Scout Troop activities and badges

L3-FAM3-02.name_en: Join District/Region activity or joint activity with other Sections

L4.purpose_en: Complete within 1.5 years after Adventure Award; partly mandatory, rest 1-2 electives

L4-OUTDOOR.desc_en: At least 2 besides mandatory knot, spiral deepening

L4-CREATIVE.desc_en: At least 1; must differ from Adventure Award

L4-OUT-MAP-02.name_en: Plan a journey using HK standard map

L4-OUT-FIRE.name_en: Fire Lighting - light charcoal fire and cook

L4-OUT-COMPASS.name_en: Compass - use map and Silva compass to point direction

L4-OUT-HIKE.name_en: Hiking - plan and do hike with leader

L4-OUT-SHELTER.name_en: Shelter - build a shelter with materials

L4-OUT-CAMP.name_en: Camp - join outdoor camp and stay overnight in tent

L4-SP-01.name_en: Choose at least 2 sports/hobbies; one existing, report benefits

L4-SP-02.name_en: Try a new sport/hobby and record

L4-HELP-FA.name_en: First aid: direct pressure and triangular bandage

L4-HELP-WATER.name_en: Water safety: demo rescue and seek adult help

L4-HELP-HOME.name_en: Home safety: crime prevention, accidents, fire handling

L4-HELP-GOOD.name_en: Special good turn in Six or Pack

L4-SELF-HYGIENE.name_en: Health: personal hygiene importance and good habits

L4-SELF-HEALTH.name_en: Keep fit: know healthy foods and avoid unhealthy

L4-SELF-FOOD.name_en: Healthy food: record one-week menu, review nutrition

L4-SELF-ROAD.name_en: Road safety: pedestrian facilities, traffic signs, cycling and passenger safety

L4-SCI-WEATHER.name_en: Weather station: at least 3 instruments, record 2 weeks

L4-SCI-REPAIR.name_en: Small repair: observe adult repairing, know maintenance

L4-SCI-MODEL.name_en: Model making: make model with moving parts and report

L4-SCI-TECH.name_en: Tech gadget: use one and report

L4-SCI-ENV.name_en: Environment: design and join eco activity, submit report

L4-SCI-FARM.name_en: Green field: farming activity, avoid polluting fertiliser

L4-COM-IMPROVE.name_en: Improve community: join development activity and explain plan

L4-COM-VOLUNTEER.name_en: Little volunteer: join community group service

L4-CUL-EXCHANGE.name_en: International exchange: join activity learning other cultures or international Scouting

L4-CUL-ORG.name_en: International org: collect info on at least 2 international orgs

L4-CUL-CULTURE.name_en: Other cultures: album on traditions, customs, religions, costumes

L4-PRO-01.name_en: Make diary recording daily practice of Promise and Law

L4-FAM4-01.name_en: Know how Scout Troop patrol system works, list 3 differences from Cub Six

L4-FAM4-02.name_en: Know Scout Troop badge system and differences from Cubs

L5.purpose_en: Highest honour, apply after 9.5y and Adventure Crest, awarded 10.5-12y, extendable if still primary
L5.description_en: Assessment: outdoor, adventure challenge, sharing, leadership, at least 1 activity badge

L5-CAMP.desc_en: Must complete Adventure Crest outdoor first; at least 2 nights as Cub

L5-HIKE.desc_en: In small groups, share after, discuss route with leader

L5-ACT.desc_en: At least 1 designated during assessment; if already earned, take other/higher

L5-CAMP-02.name_en: Help pitch and strike a tent

L5-CAMP-03.name_en: Handle and maintain pitched tent at campsite

L5-CAMP-05.name_en: Help cook, serve and tidy a meal at camp

L5-CAMP-06.name_en: Know basic camp hygiene and safety

L5-HIKE-02.name_en: Know how to pack outdoor gear

L5-HIKE-03.name_en: Complete at least 6km hike using compass and map

L5-ADV-NIGHT-01.name_en: Know night activity safety and equipment

L5-ADV-NIGHT-02.name_en: Complete trail in groups of max 2

L5-ADV-CLIMB.name_en: Sport Climbing - safety and equipment with instructor, at least twice on artificial wall

L5-ADV-ROPE.name_en: Children's Ropes Course - safety rules with instructor, at least 3 different elements

L5-ACT-01.name_en: Designated activity badges L1 or L3 system: Cyclist/Swimmer/Pioneer/Park Orienteer/Map Reader/Athlete/Sailor/Canoe/Boatman/Archer/Fitness

L5-LEAD-01.name_en: Complete an activity under leader, taking role: preparation, leading, review sharing

L5-LEAD-02.name_en: Assist Pack activity - as Cub lead a Pack activity with older Cubs as main role

L5-PION-01.name_en: Build simple shelter/tarp with bamboo and natural materials/substitutes

L5-PION-02.name_en: Complete figure-of-eight, square, diagonal lashings before leader

L5-PION-03.name_en: Make simple pioneering using above lashings (not for climbing/crossing/heavy load)

L5-COOK-03.name_en: Cook a meal for yourself without stove/utensils

L5-COOK-04.name_en: Cook food in three different ways

L5-SVC-01.name_en: Continuous service under leader: at least 8 times and at least 8 hours total

L5-SVC-02.name_en: After service, give at least 3-min talk sharing purpose, target, learning, memorable experience

ACT-CYCLIST.desc_en: Elementary red, intermediate yellow, advanced green

ACT-CAMP.desc_en: Join 2 outdoor camps, prepare gear, pitch/strike tent, maintain, simple gadget, help cook, hygiene, safety, clear site, 2D1N

ACT-CANOE.desc_en: 1-star Seahorse, 2-star Seal, 3-star Walrus, swimming test required

ACT-07.desc_en: Official Cub activity badge; check official syllabus 2025-08 for requirements.

trainingPlan.title_en: Cub Scout Section Training Scheme (2025-08 Online Draft Simplified)
trainingPlan.purpose_en: Cub Scout Section aims to promote children's physical, mental and spiritual development, with 4 progressive badges as core, supplemented by activity badges, plus Scout Link Badge
method_en: Progressive badges: Award / Adventure / Adventure Crest / Golden Bauhinia
trainingPlan.progressFlow_en: Membership → Cub Scout Award → Adventure Award → Adventure Crest → Golden Bauhinia Award
trainingPlan.assessmentPrinciples_en: All badges assessed by Pack Scouter or suitable persons appointed by Association/Region/District training courses; Pack Scouter has final decision and issuance. At least 1/4 of Pack should attain higher level each year. This system is an e-record book and leader checking tool; official issuance, application and safety requirements follow Association's latest notices and official forms.

PT67.name_en: Golden Bauhinia Award Commencement Notice PT/67
